_readme: Edit this file, then run: python marketing/ad/build/build.py  (add --recapture to re-record the website first). Prices MUST match what the live site shows (admin > designs / settings). Placeholders in captions/VO: {minimal} {mandala} {bridal} {mandala_advance} {advance} {full_hours} {partial_hours} {partial_pct}.

cta.line: Book on the VAISHORA website — pay a small advance to lock your artist.
cta.fineprint: {advance}% advance online · balance to the artist after the session · cancel {full_hours}h+ before: full refund of the advance · Hyderabad only

voice._engines: edge = edge-tts (free, see ASSETS.md licence note) | azure = Azure AI Speech (set AZURE_SPEECH_KEY and AZURE_SPEECH_REGION) | files = your own recordings in marketing/ad/audio/vo_override/<scene>.wav
voice.name: hi-IN-SwaraNeural

scenes.caption: Mehndi ka rate poocha… | reply aaya, *“DM karo.”*
scenes.vo: मेहंदी का रेट पूछा, | रिप्लाई आया: डी-एम करो!

scenes.caption: Design *3D haath* pe dekho, price ke saath — | *{minimal} se shuru.*
scenes.vo: वैशोरा पे डिज़ाइन थ्री-डी हाथ पे देखो, प्राइस के साथ, | {minimal_vo} से शुरू।
scenes.fineprint: Price ek haath ka, design jaisa dikhaya. Final quote payment se pehle dikhega.

scenes.caption: Bas *{advance}% advance* do — slot lock. | *Baaki session ke baad.*
scenes.vo: बस {advance} परसेंट एडवांस दो, स्लॉट लॉक। | बाक़ी सेशन के बाद।

scenes.caption: Palm ya back — | *ghuma ke dekho.*
scenes.vo: पाम या बैक — | घुमा के देखो।

scenes.caption: Date, time chuno — | *artist aapke ghar aayenge.*
scenes.vo: डेट, टाइम चुनो — | आर्टिस्ट आपके घर आएँगे।

scenes.caption: Plan badla? *{full_hours} ghante pehle* cancel — | *poora advance wapas.*
scenes.vo: प्लान बदला? {full_hours} घंटे पहले कैंसल, | पूरा एडवांस वापस।
scenes.fineprint: {partial_hours}–{full_hours} ghante pehle: {partial_pct}% refund · {partial_hours} ghante se kam: refund nahi.

scenes.caption: Artists ko *hamari team* | *review karti hai.*
scenes.vo: आर्टिस्ट्स को हमारी टीम | रिव्यू करती है।

scenes.caption: Apna design chuno, slot lock karo — | *VAISHORA pe abhi book karo.*
scenes.vo: अपना डिज़ाइन चुनो, स्लॉट लॉक करो — | वैशोरा पे अभी बुक करो!
